newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to issue T-bills on October 22.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to issue T-bills on October 22.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank will auction three-month, six-month, nine-month and 12-month discount treasury bills on October 22, a central bank official said on Monday.

The volume of three-month T-bills was set at five million hryvnias and the volume of six-month T-bills was set at 13 million hryvnias, the head of the bank's market and exchange dapartment, Vitaly Migashko, told Reuters.
The central bank is not setting the issue volume of 9-month and 12-month T-bills in advance.

At the last auction of three-month discount T-bills on October 17, the bank sold 6 million hryvnias worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 43.09 percent. The average price was 90.30 hryvnias.

At the last auction of six-month discount T-bills on October 17, the bank sold 9.01 million hryvnias worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 49.20 percent. The average price was 80.30 hryvnias.

At the last auction of nine-month discount T-bills on October 17, the bank sold 2.89 million hryvnias worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 59.76 percent. The average price was 69.11 hryvnias.
At the last auction of 12-month discount T-bills on October 17, the bank sold 33,200 hryvnias worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 60.86 percent. The average price was 62.23 hryvnias.
